title.narrative: PARSA. Capacity-building program for reintegration and social protection II. 2022-2023.

description.narrative: The objective is to expand the services offered to returnees through PARSA's Transition to Community Program, creating a network of support for sustainable reintegration. This among other things includes building a capacity program that will support the reintegration process. Additionally, the objective is to implement and manage the establishment of a model Trade Afghan Economic Center at the Kabul Marastoon to serve as a training center for ARCS program staff to initiate the replication of Trade Afghan economic centers in the other four Marastoons.

title.narrative: Output 1.1: PARSA's capacity to deliver return services is maintained. Returnees are enrolled in the Transition to Community program, with the priority being those from Denmark. All program beneficiaries develop individualized plans and have access to holistic range of reintegration services.
Number of returnees participating in reintegration program with reintegration plan and participating in requisite services.

target.value: March 2023: Workforce Training Program development complete, manual/materials complete Trade Afghan program introduced to all Marastoon directors 20 program beneficiaries (returnees) recruited into program and participating in services

actual.value: All past beneficiaries on track or have successfully completed their reintegration. PARSA continues to work with 4 out of 8 returnees who joined the program in 2021. Official opening of Trade Afghan Economic Center (TAEC) and Trade Afghan delayed due to legal constraints on all NGO activities. Recruitment of ARCS beneficiaries postponed until Trade Afghan facilities are open to conduct the program.

target.value: September 2023: 100% of program beneficiaries successfully reintegrated or on track for successful reintegration

actual.value: Throughout phase II PARSA continually maintained capacity to serve up to 30 returnees referred from Denmark. Due to political constraints related to the de facto Taliban government, Denmark was only able to send three returnees to PARSA’s program during the course of this contract, each of whom have full access to PARSA services. PARSA also continued to work with 15 returnees from Denmark and other countries through the Brothers 4 Brothers International program.

actual.value: Development of TA Workforce training program complete. Eight participants in the Workforce program achieved full-time employment. Expansion of this component paused as Trade Afghan Economic Center opening was postponed. Plans for regional marketing postponed.

target.value: March 2023:Foundation for TA Business Network established.

actual.value: Enrollment process postponed until Trade Afghan Economic Center opened and operational. Waiting list of 20 businesses.

actual.value: Involvement of Marastoon staff postponed due to operational circumstances related to government and NGOs. PTI training materials are under development. Training workshops in Kabul and provinces are postponed due to operational circumstances related to government and NGOs.

target.value: September 2023: Two Marastoon program staff are participating in planning meetings for economic centers. 25 participants in training workshops, planning meetings, and individual consulting Training materials for PTI Training Program finalized PTI Training workshop in conducted in Kabul PTI training programs conducted in Balkh, Kandahar, Nangarhar, and Herat

actual.value: PARSA has introduced Marastoon directors to the Transition to Community Program and the Trade Afghan Economic Program. Furthering the technical relationship including through training Marastoon staff in PARSA programs is planned for phase III. Regional activities continue to be postponed due to the political operating environment however these activities are also planned for phase III as part of the establishment of regional economic hubs.

target.value: March 2023: Mapping of agencies and resources for returnees

actual.value: This output was delayed as due to the ban on female participation, as PARSA was not able to open the Kabul Trade Afghan Economic Center until November 2023. title.narrative: Outcome 2: A Trade Afghan Economic Center is established in the Kabul Marastoon and serves as a model for replication for economic centers in the other four Marastoons, supporting returnees, ARCS beneficiaries, and PSN in working toward economic independence.

The model Trade Afghan Economic Center in Kabul is fully operational, serving Kabul beneficiaries and functioning as a central hub for income generation and as a learning center for the regional Marastoons and for other non-governmental agencies working on reintegration.

target.value: TA Economic Center in Kabul fully operational, generating revenue and employment opportunities for beneficiaries, and hosting workshops.

actual.value: Staffing and infrastructure complete and the TAEC has been established. Full TAEC opening postponed due to operational circumstances related to government and NGOs. Additional revenue generation and workshops postponed due to operational circumstances related to government and NGOs.

target.value: TA Economic Center in Kabul fully operational, generating revenue and employment opportunities for beneficiaries, and hosting workshops.

actual.value: Staffing and infrastructure were completed during the course of this contract and the TAEC is fully operational. The TAEC opening was postponed due to the restrictions on female engagement until November 2023, when it was opened under the agreement that female beneficiaries would be permitted. Revenue generation is ongoing through PARSA in-house businesses and a public-private partnership with a lapidary firm is under negotiation as of project close, which would generate both revenue for PARSA and income-generation opportunities for beneficiaries including returnees.

title.narrative: Outcome 1: Services offered to returnees through PARSA's Transition to Community program are expanded, creating a network of support for sustainable reintegration.

PARSA program will support the sustainable reintegration of existing returnees including Danish voluntary returnees and recruit and induct additional returnees into the PARSA Transition to Community program. PARSA's current reintegration services will be further developed and new services added.

target.value: Program ready for regional scale-up and implementation in four remaining Marastoons.

actual.value: PARSA successfully secured permission from the de facto authorities for conducting the Transition to Community program. Program components were adjusted to the new context and all returnees referred to the program had full access to program services. Regional scale up in planned for phase III through the introduction of Trade Afghan hubs in each Marastoon. The program was introduced to other entities working with returnees in Afghanistan, however due to operational challenges in the current context, efforts to train other NGOs in delivery of program components were delayed.
